QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Departure
QuestInfo.0: Back in the village, the caravan and a big Shrelephant are ready and waiting for you. It's Ullan's pet Shrelephant, Elle! Thankfully, all of the villagers departed for the village across the river with nary a straggler in sight!
